MBEUMO OR CUNHA: IS THIS DEBATE ALREADY OVER? 🤔

Both Manchester United attackers cost £8.0m, but Mbeumo could have the major FPL advantage of playing out of position.l due to Sesko not featuring yet in pre season.

Under Michael Carrick last season, Mbeumo has played nine matches as the forward:

⚽️ Five goals
🅰️ Two assists

Cunha finished only five FPL points behind Mbeumo last season and could thrive playing off him, but can you overlook a midfielder potentially starting through the middle?

Does Mbeumo’s central role make him the obvious pick, or are you still backing Cunha? 👇

NEW DEFCON MIDFIELDERS TO WATCH 🧲

These new Premier League arrivals posted some huge defensive-contribution numbers last season.

All data is per 90:

🐝 Mamadou Sangaré: 14.19 DC | £5.5m
🚜 Florentino: 13.40 DC | £5.0m
🐘 Caleb Yirenkyi: 13.05 DC | £5.0m
🍬 Christian Nørgaard: 12.93 DC | £5.0m
⚪ Shea Charles: 11.23 DC | £5.0m

Nørgaard’s figure was recorded during his time at Brentford.

Which of these potential DEFCON magnets is the best FPL enabler? 👇
